Spec: Canvas locked to 1080x1920 (9:16) at generation time
Why (mobile-native viewing): Platforms classify native vertical at upload time; letterboxing added afterwards is detected as non-native
Prompt assembly rule: Open the prompt with the canvas spec: 竖屏 9:16 / vertical 9:16 composition. Midjourney uses --ar 9:16; API families take 1080x1920
Validation check: Exported frame is exactly 1080x1920 with no letterbox
Common failure: Generated at 16:9 then centre-cropped, so hair or chin is clipped
Fix action: Regenerate at 9:16. Never crop a 16:9 master

Spec: Top SAFE_TOP_PCT% carries no face, no key prop, no readable detail
Why (mobile-native viewing): The platform draws status and account chrome over the top of the frame
Prompt assembly rule: Keep the subject's crown below the band. Describe framing as headroom-limited: 头顶留白受限 / tight headroom
Validation check: Face and all P0 anchors sit fully below the top band
Common failure: Faces placed at the very top get clipped by chrome on device
Fix action: Recompose with the subject lowered. Do not move the camera up to compensate

Spec: Bottom SAFE_BOTTOM_PCT% carries no mouth, no handheld prop, no key detail
Why (mobile-native viewing): Burned subtitles and interaction buttons occupy the bottom of the frame
Prompt assembly rule: State the subtitle band explicitly: 字幕区在下 SAFE_BOTTOM_PCT% 内 / subtitle-safe bottom margin
Validation check: Mouth region and any P0 prop sit above the bottom band
Common failure: Subtitles land on the mouth so lip-sync becomes invisible
Fix action: Raise the subject or move the subtitle block up. Never scale the whole frame down

Spec: Eyes must fall inside the vertical band around EYELINE_PCT from the top
Why (mobile-native viewing): Cover thumbnails crop the frame; eyes outside the crop mean a faceless card
Prompt assembly rule: Describe the eye line rather than the head position: 眼睛位于画面上三分之一 / eyes on upper third
Validation check: Compare the eye line against the actual thumbnail crop rectangle
Common failure: Character reads as faceless or headless on the cover card
Fix action: Re-stage vertically. Do not rely on later editor cropping

Spec: At 9:16 the horizontal field is narrow: a horizontal-medium shot holds 1-2 people maximum, and a 16:9 wide becomes a close-quarters two-shot
Why (mobile-native viewing): Every shot scale learned from 16:9 silently means something one step tighter
Prompt assembly rule: Rewrite the scale in vertical terms: 竖屏中景仅容 1-2 人 / vertical medium = two-shot maximum
Validation check: Count bodies in frame against the stated scale
Common failure: Third character enters a shot labelled medium and gets sliced by the frame edge
Fix action: Split into two shots or convert to front-back depth staging (VF-07)

Spec: Horizontal background chains (corridor, skyline, row of windows, table line) must be re-authored as vertical stacks: ceiling-to-floor, foreground pillar, upper and lower planes
Why (mobile-native viewing): Horizontal vanishing lines have almost no room to read in a narrow frame
Prompt assembly rule: Replace lateral chains with vertical ones in the prompt: 纵向层次 / foreground pillar / floor-to-ceiling depth
Validation check: Background still reads as a receding corridor
Common failure: 背景 washed out into mush because the model compressed a horizontal axis that does not exist
Fix action: Re-author the background sentence using vertical anchors

Spec: Two-person dialogue uses front-back depth or a left/right half-frame split. Never side-by-side at equal distance
Why (mobile-native viewing): Equal-distance side-by-side two-shots collapse into two half-people at 9:16
Prompt assembly rule: Write the staging explicitly: 前后纵深 or 各占左右半屏, and bind it to the facing tokens in OrientationTokenBank
Validation check: Both faces fully inside the safe frame and at different depths or different halves
Common failure: Eyeline match breaks because both characters stand on the same line
Fix action: Restage per the rule. Do not fix in the editor

Spec: Prefer vertical moves (rise, fall, push-in, tilt) over lateral pan; lateral pan leaves the 9:16 frame faster
Why (mobile-native viewing): A lateral pan crosses the narrow axis in a fraction of the time it needs at 16:9
Prompt assembly rule: Pair every move with a direction and a speed per VideoGenerationPromptTemplate universal red line: 缓慢上摇 / slow rise
Validation check: Move direction is stated and is vertical by default
Common failure: Lateral pan exits the subject within the first second and the rest of the clip is empty
Fix action: Re-generate with a vertical move. Do not stabilise or reframe a lateral pan in post

Spec: Burned subtitles never overlap the mouth region. If the mouth falls in the bottom third, the subtitle block moves up
Why (mobile-native viewing): An overlapped mouth makes the lip-sync pass unverifiable
Prompt assembly rule: Reserve the mouth region in the shot spec before writing the dialogue line
Validation check: Frame-step the dialogue beat and confirm the mouth is unobstructed
Common failure: Subtitle sits on the chin and the lip-sync review cannot be done
Fix action: Move the subtitle block. Re-shoot only if the mouth is also in VF-03's band

Spec: Every vertical rule above is checked per shot, not per episode
Why (mobile-native viewing): A composition fixed in the editor is a shot that will not survive the next edit
Prompt assembly rule: One vertical spec block per shot, reused verbatim within a scene
Validation check: All P0 rows above pass on the exported frame
Common failure: P0 failures are regenerations, not edits
